# ghost/glider

Read public Hacker News stories and comments anonymously in Glider. Browse categories, list story titles/points/comment counts and read visible discussion text without accounts or engagement.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/glider
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/glider open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/glider read_stories --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/glider select_category --device <serial> --param category=<category>
ghost skill run ghost/glider open_comments --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/glider read_comments --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/glider scroll --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/glider back_to_stories --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open the anonymous Hacker News frontpage
- `read_stories`: List complete visible stories with points and comment counts
- `select_category`: Select a public frontpage story category
- `open_comments`: Open the internal discussion for a visible story
- `read_comments`: Read exposed comment bodies in the current discussion viewport
- `scroll`: Scroll one public story or discussion viewport and read it
- `back_to_stories`: Return from a discussion to the story listing
